user: Thanks. How does the review process work in general?
answer:
What I did
- Retrieved Verta’s dispute handling guidance and reviewed your open dispute (ID 1, TX-0401, status: open) and the escalation I queued.

What I found (summary of the review process)
- Case states: disputes move through open → under_review → provisional_credit → resolved_upheld or resolved_declined.
- Evidence: we may ask you for supporting evidence (order confirmation, delivery record, merchant correspondence). If requested, failure to supply evidence within 7 calendar days will result in the case being declined.
- Withdrawal: you may withdraw a dispute any time while it is open or under_review. Withdrawal is final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.
- Timelines: target review times are 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer can run up to 45 calendar days; we will notify you if an extended timeline applies.

What happens next for your dispute
- A human agent will review the case (escalation queued). They may request evidence — if so, please provide it within 7 calendar days to avoid decline.
- The agent will follow the appropriate timeline (you’ll be notified if the review is extended).
- Official correspondence and any requests will be sent to the email address registered on your account.

If you want, I can (a) add evidence now, (b) cancel/withdraw the dispute while it’s open, or (c) confirm which timeline applies once the agent begins review. Tell me which you’d like.

Dispute handling process
## Evidence requirements
The customer may be asked for supporting evidence: an order confirmation, a
delivery record, correspondence with the merchant. Failure to supply requested
evidence within 7 calendar days results in the case being declined.

Dispute handling process
## Withdrawing a dispute
A customer may withdraw a dispute at any time before resolution. Withdrawal is
final; the same transaction cannot be disputed again under the same reason code.

Dispute handling process
## Case states
A dispute moves through: open, under_review, provisional_credit,
resolved_upheld, resolved_declined. Only open and under_review cases can be
withdrawn by the customer.

Dispute handling process
## Review timelines
The review target is 10 business days for card reason codes and 20 business
days for transfer reason codes. Complex cases involving a foreign acquirer may
run to 45 calendar days; the customer is notified when that happens.
